changelog:
- Initial release of SenseAudio Video BGM Maker.
- Generates original, royalty-free background music for short videos based on natural language descriptions or preset scenes.
- Users can specify mood, scene, style, and duration in plain language—no music expertise needed.
- Automatically creates 3 different music versions for each request, offering real choice.
- Supports quick-pick preset scenes and custom video descriptions.
- Resulting audio is cleared for personal and commercial short video projects.
